limitations: The successful read-only publisher measurement ran exactly one repository command for the fixed TE-00 comparison task and made one tool-protocol call.
The controlled case publishes its result only to the parent task; external pull-request publication, merge, and cleanup phases were intentionally not performed.

Artifact bytes retain only the compact deterministic comparison payload; the separately retained full record is bound by report digest and contains no prompt, source body, command output, or private path.
Raw local rollout usage is not billed API cost or exact subscription-credit consumption.
Guardian routing and approval policy were not invoked in this controlled case and are not repository-engine gains.
orchestration: one default measurement agent on gpt-5.6-sol high; no child agents or guardians; deterministic harness uses disposable local clones and makes no model or provider call

activeWallExcludingUserIdle.limitation: This span includes initial task preparation, deterministic execution, and final result delivery.
activeWallExcludingUserIdle.method: task_started to task_complete event span with no end-user message or coordination pause inside the child task

approvalWait.limitation: This zero is specific to the read-only controlled case and is not a repository guarantee.
approvalWait.method: absence of approval or guardian events in the controlled child rollout

completion.limitation: Token-count events are response aggregates and cannot separate model queue, prefill, and completion latency.

coordinationWait.limitation: Final result delivery to the parent is publication, not an observed coordination wait.
coordinationWait.method: absence of child-to-parent clarification and parent-reply spans before task completion

firstToken.limitation: The rollout does not expose first streamed-token timestamps.

modelRequest.limitation: The rollout does not expose model request-start timestamps.

cleanup.limitation: Disposable clones were removed inside the measured command; no separate agent cleanup phase was observable.

implementation.limitation: The task-start to invocation preparation span remains included only in active wall time.
implementation.method: fixed-comparison command invocation through compact digest-addressed output

merge.limitation: No branch or pull request was merged in this measurement-only case.

publication.limitation: This is result publication to the parent task, not external pull-request publication.
publication.method: compact comparison output through verbatim result delivery to the parent task

toolDuration.limitation: This measures local call-to-output emission, not model latency.
toolDuration.method: one paired fixed-comparison tool call-to-output event span
